subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB603
title: Requires the Oregon Department of Administrative Services to establish guidelines for state agencies to follow in designing programs and establishing budgets for ongoing or multiyear activities that state agencies intend to fund with grant moneys.
headline: SB 603 did not pass

claims.text: SB 603 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
